description: Complete attachment management component that combines TmFileDropZone with a list of existing attachments loaded via ITmAttachmentProvider. Upload and URL resolution are handled through ITmFileProvider.

parameters.name: AttachmentProvider
parameters.description: Provider for loading and linking attachments to an entity.

parameters.name: FileProvider
parameters.description: Provider for uploading files and resolving asset URLs.

parameters.name: EntityRef
parameters.description: Entity reference used to load and upload attachments.

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: Entity ID used to load and upload attachments.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description: Entity type used with EntityId. Defaults to attachment-manager-entity.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: When true, upload and delete controls are disabled.

parameters.name: MaxUploadSize
parameters.description: Maximum size of a single upload in bytes. Default 100 MB. Also caps the browser read stream.

parameters.name: ScanHook
parameters.description: Optional scan hook run after each upload; a Blocked result marks the file unavailable.

parameters.name: OnUploadProgress
parameters.description: Fires for each chunk progress update during a chunked upload.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: OnDeleted
parameters.description: Fires when an attachment is deleted.

usedAbstractions.name: ITmFileProvider
usedAbstractions.description: Provider for file upload and URL resolution

usedAbstractions.name: TmAttachment
usedAbstractions.description: Shared model representing a file attachment
